title: Design: Credit Limit locks at $0.00 for COD on Edit Customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure customer A is on Net 30 with a credit limit of $5,000.00.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p6-06-edit-customer-cod-or-credit-hold-locks-the-limit.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the customer page of customer A.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the pencil on the customer card.
  2. Choose "COD" in Credit Terms.
  3. Hover Credit Limit.
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "Edit Customer" window opens.

Step 2:

  • Credit Limit reads "$ 0.00", greyed.

Step 3:

  • A dark grey box opens under the field reading "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." (as in ct-p6-06-edit-customer-cod-or-credit-hold-locks-the-limit.png).

Step 4:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R4: “When the chosen term is COD or Credit Hold, Credit Limit shows $0.00 and is disabled; hovering it shows "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." Choosing COD or Credit Hold sets the limit to $0.00.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover the locked Credit Limit (COD or Credit Hold) | "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." | Tooltip on hover”
